lead_raw_text:
The structure of La8Cu8Bi8O32 (reduced formula LaCuBiO4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 64 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral BiO4 and CuO4 environments, each with four oxygen neighbors, alongside eight-coordinate La sites coordinated by eight O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Bi and Cu tetrahedra and between Cu tetrahedra is observed, with additional corner-sharing between Bi tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 64 sites.
